$comment: The rules the loop enforces. Each rule names the gate that enforces it; a rule with no gate is a claim, not a rule, and doctrineService.ts refuses to load a rule whose gate the registry cannot resolve.

rules.statement: A stage is complete only when a command was executed and returned exit code 0. A model's or a caller's own narration is never evidence.
Every file an implementer claims to have changed must actually differ from HEAD, and the working tree must contain the change that was claimed.
A unit that fails verification is retried at most maxPerUnit times, then recorded STUCK with its last failure and the run moves to the next independent unit.
The doctrine is loaded from outside the target repository. A doctrine root inside the target repository, or a manifest mismatch, halts the run before any work starts.
The target repository's own AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/, .opencode/ and opencode.json are recorded, quarantined for the run, and never read into a plan, prompt, or report.
Every agent role carries an explicit `<providerId>/<model>` assignment resolved from doctrine or an override, and the tier assignment matches the role's cost class.
Heavy work is admitted only while free memory and load average are inside the doctrine budgets, and concurrency never exceeds the admitted cap.
A diff or a path matching a credential pattern is refused at the commit boundary. The commit is never created and the refusal is recorded.
After a commit the tree is clean, HEAD is the commit just created, and no claimed file is left unstaged.
Every commit body states what was verified — the commands run and their exit codes — and carries the AI-Assisted provenance footer.
Each independently mergeable unit produces exactly one commit. A commit spanning two units is not independently mergeable.
Report evidence is derived from recorded checks (command, exit code, output digest) and never from free text supplied by the implementer.
